title: 1729 is the smallest number special in two ways
body: Hardy told Ramanujan his taxi number 1729 seemed dull; Ramanujan replied it is the smallest number expressible as a sum of two cubes in two different ways: 1^3+12^3 and 9^3+10^3. Whether he had memorised the fact or saw it instantly is argued; the number now anchors 'taxicab' mathematics.
